content: Welcome to WikiDoc. Thank you for visiting WikiDoc. WikiDoc is the first and largest wiki platform dedicated exclusively to the field of medicine. It serves as an online community where anyone can contribute to and edit the world’s largest free, continuously updated medical textbook. This collaborative process is referred to as Co-creation. All contributions to the platform are carefully monitored and reviewed by medical professionals who serve as Editors-in-Chief. To contribute, you only need basic knowledge of how to use a word processor. Hundreds of individuals actively contribute to WikiDoc, and you can view their most recent edits and additions by visiting the Recent Changes page. Anyone can explore WikiDoc by entering a topic of interest into the search box or by browsing through the available categories. If you wish to add content or make edits to the site and receive proper credit for your contributions, you will need to create a username.
